name: Siren MinterAmm withdrawCapital ERC1155 callback reentrancy
summary: MinterAmm.withdrawCapital burned LP and snapshotted the AMM's collateral, then sent the redeemer's ERC1155 option tokens before paying collateral and had no reentrancy guard. The attacker re-entered withdrawCapital from onERC1155Received, so nested withdrawals were priced against a stale collateral balance, draining six Siren Polygon AMMs.
notes: The AMM proxy constructor fixed MinterAmm 0xca84835655a8e863d34875326419a46f823320f6 as its logic; no CodeAddressUpdated occurred before the exploit, so the proxy's creation is when the reentrant withdrawCapital became active for this context. Five sibling AMMs share the runtime and logic.

Net collateral each AMM paid to the attack contract, less collateral the attacker supplied in the same transaction, across the six exploit transactions; liquid assets at DefiLlama quotes before each leg, USDC at par. loss.mjs over the same txs gives $3,470,900. ERC1155 option tokens are not valued.
